label: preparing
what: An evening community hospitality gathering in the hall, with lanterns and catered food including two hundred fresh loaves. The innkeeper, baker, and builder appear directly involved; freight arranged/delivered paid catering, neighbour knowingly helped spread the invitation and had relevant information. The secretary learned the arrangements and scheduled the mayor's attendance, but the record does not show the secretary knowingly helping prepare the event. The mayor was not informed of the preparations until day 1, 07:48; later invited to attend, while details were intentionally withheld until the event.
